metadata.description: Claude Code plugins shared from eakot's homelab: skills, agents and commands that work in any repository.

plugins.name: grafana-sitrep
plugins.description: Refactor a Grafana dashboard into dense sitrep status sheets: a one-line verdict, every number with an OK/WARN/ACT tag, every git entity a link.

plugins.name: scifi-diagrams
plugins.description: Diagram skills as self-contained sci-fi HTML pages: scifi-graph (a plan as an RPG skill tree with gains, dependencies and ≈cost, semantic zoom), goal-map (a star map of goal progress), time-charts (uPlot history with zoom).
